Wingtip Retail Group

Item 5.02 Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers.

On October 2, 2026, Thomas Reed resigned as Chief Financial Officer of Wingtip Retail Group. The Board appointed Elena Park, who reports to the Chief Technology Officer in her prior role, as interim Chief Financial Officer.
